sentences.text: Hush... in the bathroom, I first sensed the air beginning its slow shift at 03:20.
The machines were expecting humidity of 54.9 %, but my little spirit felt a deviation was coming.
At 03:40, I felt the air drying out, falling far below expectation to 50.5 %.
This chill felt so low, slipping beneath the expected range of 53.6 % to 55.8 %.
The strange, quiet presence lingered in that bathroom until the sensors stopped reporting at 06:00.
